label: preparing
what: Innkeeper is organizing a gathering with refreshments in the great hall today at 18:00, with builder and freight helping. Its further details are deliberately confidential until that hour, although I have been invited and approved the hall reservation. Secretary knowingly helps by recording the reservation and arranging to escort me. Refreshments are privately on the innkeeper's credit. It might commemorate my forty years of service, but that purpose remains unconfirmed; builder seeking wheat may relate to refreshments but is not proof.
